units.zh: 方案B先分兵，让两支军队分别到合格驻点休整，再会合。
units.en: Plan B splits the army. Both groups rest at qualifying locations, then reunite.

units.zh: 这里看一次独立的B回放：
units.en: Here is an independent replay of B.

units.zh: 在已核对的停驻窗口，两军当前补给月变化都读到正二十。
units.en: During the checked rest window, both armies showed a current supply change of +20 per month.

units.zh: 它只说当时的读数，不表示库存已经增加。
units.en: That was the current rate. It does not show that supply had already increased.

units.zh: 后面分别看人数和库存的实际变化；
units.en: Next, we observe actual soldier and supply changes separately.

units.zh: 实际合军之后，还要重新核对兵团与统帅条件，
units.en: After the actual merge, we must check the regiments and commander again.

units.zh: 伦敦终点仍未读到。
units.en: There is still no observed London endpoint for B.

units.zh: 方案C换路线，先经过已核验的中转点，再去伦敦。
units.en: Plan C takes a different route, through verified waypoints to London.

units.zh: 这次独立回放，在共同起点后的第七十七个游戏日，
units.en: In this independent replay, on game day 77 after the shared start,

units.zh: 我们首次观察到主力已经抵达伦敦；
units.en: we first observed the main army in London.

units.zh: 第七十五日它还在路上，
units.en: It was still en route on day 75.

units.zh: 所以实际到达在这两次观察之间，精确时刻未知。
units.en: It arrived between those observations. The exact moment is unknown.

units.zh: 这支主力从六千六百七十九人出发，
units.en: This main army started with 6,679 soldiers.

units.zh: 到达观测时是六千六百八十九，净增十人；
units.en: At the arrival observation, it had 6,689: a net gain of ten.

units.zh: 完整二十七个兵团的身份与满员数不变。
units.en: All 27 regiments retained their identities and maximum soldier counts.

units.zh: 补给从约一百一十点三八降到一百零一点九零，
units.en: Supply fell from about 110.38 to 101.90.

units.zh: 容量仍三百。
units.en: Supply capacity remained 300.

units.zh: 终点当前损耗读到百分之一，
units.en: Current attrition at the endpoint was 1%.

units.zh: 这是当时的条件读数，不能直接换算成旅途中死了多少兵。
units.en: That was the rate under current conditions. It does not tell us how many died en route.

units.zh: 这里报的是主力的原始编制，
units.en: These figures describe the original main army.

units.zh: 不是玩家所有单位的总人数。
units.en: They are not the total soldiers in all player units.

units.zh: 前面的平分样本里，两队都继承约一百一十点三八补给，
units.en: In the earlier equal split, both armies inherited about 110.38 supply.

units.zh: 主军容量三百，新分队容量一百。
units.en: The main army had capacity 300; the new group had capacity 100.

units.zh: 现在看这次B回放：
units.en: Now look at this replay of B.

units.zh: 起点后的第二十到二十一日，新分队库存从约一百一十点三八降到一百，
units.en: Between days 20 and 21, the new group's supply fell from about 110.38 to 100.

units.zh: 两军人数与完整兵团的前后读数都没变。
units.en: Both armies' soldier counts and full regiment readings were unchanged.

units.zh: 虽然当前月变化仍是正二十，
units.en: The current monthly rate still showed +20.

units.zh: 这次库存变化却是向下回到容量；
units.en: But the actual supply change was downward, back to capacity.

units.zh: 它不是补兵，也不是低库存补给增加。
units.en: This was neither reinforcement nor a supply increase from a low stock.

units.zh: 接着看两个不同的窗口。
units.en: Next, consider two separate observation windows.

units.zh: 起点后的第二十六到二十七日，主军人数净增七，新分队净增三，
units.en: Between days 26 and 27, the main army gained seven soldiers net; the new group gained three.

units.zh: 两端库存相同。
units.en: Supply was unchanged at both endpoints.

units.zh: 第三十一到三十二日，主军补给从约一百零六点一四升到一百二十六点一四，
units.en: Between days 31 and 32, main-army supply rose from about 106.14 to 126.14.

units.zh: 新分队两端都是一百，
units.en: The new group had 100 at both endpoints.

units.zh: 完整兵团的人数与编制也没变。
units.en: The full regiment roster and soldier counts were also unchanged.

units.zh: 人数净变化与补给增加各记自己的日期，
units.en: Record soldier changes and supply gains on their own dates.

units.zh: 不能剪成同一次结算。
units.en: Do not edit them into a single update.

units.zh: 后来两军回到同地实际合军，
units.en: Later, the two armies reunited at the same location and actually merged.

units.zh: 合前补给约一百二十六点一四和一百。
units.en: Before merging, their supply was about 126.14 and 100.

units.zh: 按双方各自的合军权重加权、分别取整，
units.en: Apply each army's merge weight and round down each contribution.

units.zh: 得到约一百一十三点零六。
units.en: The result is about 113.06.

units.zh: 合后容量读到一百，库存实际也是一百。
units.en: After merging, capacity was 100, and actual supply was also 100.

units.zh: 这个窗口能单独确认上限截断，
units.en: This window independently confirms the upper-cap clamp.

units.zh: 不能用两队库存的普通平均代替。
units.en: A simple average of the two supply stocks cannot replace that calculation.

units.zh: 结果表按同日期或同事件对齐：
units.en: Align results by the same date or event.

units.zh: 先看实际抵达，再看完整兵团与可用人数，
units.en: First check actual arrival, then the full regiments and available soldiers.

units.zh: 然后是库存、补员和损耗窗口，最后是实际支付。
units.en: Then check supply, reinforcement and attrition windows, and finally actual payments.

units.zh: 这次B合军后，原二十七个兵团仍在，
units.en: After B's merge, all 27 original regiments remained.

units.zh: 但又多出一条满员一人的兵团记录；
units.en: But a new regiment record appeared, with one soldier out of a maximum of one.

units.zh: 合后共有六千六百九十人，满员六千七百四十八。
units.en: The merged army had 6,690 soldiers, out of a maximum of 6,748.

units.zh: 实际统帅也变了，与原先冻结的条件不符。
units.en: The commander also changed, breaking the conditions fixed at the start.

units.zh: 新增记录和统帅变化的原因还没有确认。
units.en: The causes of the new record and commander change remain unconfirmed.

units.zh: 因此，这次B在第三十八日停止，尚有五十二日预算；
units.en: So B stopped on day 38, with 52 days left in its budget.

units.zh: 停止是冻结条件未通过，不是时间耗尽。
units.en: It stopped because the fixed conditions failed, not because time ran out.

units.zh: 这段能保留为合军机制样本，
units.en: We can retain this as a sample of the merge mechanism.

units.zh: 却没有可比较的伦敦终点。
units.en: But it has no comparable London endpoint.

units.zh: C也出现多次采样偏差：
units.en: C also had multiple sampling deviations.

units.zh: 原计划每次最多过一天，实际跨了两天。
units.en: Pulses planned for at most one day actually advanced two.

units.zh: 后续只保留为描述性观察，
units.en: The later results are retained as descriptive observations only.

units.zh: 即使已经到达，也不能恢复成严格公平的A/C对照。
units.en: Reaching London does not restore a strictly controlled A/C comparison.

units.zh: A和C的实际到达观测各自保留。
units.en: The actual arrival observations for A and C are retained separately.

units.zh: 下面回到整军直走的A。
units.en: Now we return to A: the whole army taking the direct route.

units.zh: 同一段日期，金币余额从约六百三十七点五五，变为六百二十一点四八，
units.en: Over that period, gold fell from about 637.55 to 621.48.

units.zh: 净少十六点零六。
units.en: The net decrease was 16.06.

units.zh: 它是期间所有收支留下的净余额差，
units.en: That is the net balance change after all income and expenses.

units.zh: 不能改名为行军费，也不能当作已经核验的登船付款。
units.en: It is not a march-cost ledger or a verified embarkation payment.

units.zh: 另看换路线的C回放：
units.en: Now consider C's replay using a different route.

units.zh: 从共同起点到它的到达观测，余额净少约十五点八二金币。
units.en: From the shared start to its arrival observation, gold decreased by about 15.82 net.

units.zh: 这个数字同样只是净变化。
units.en: That figure is also only a net change.

units.zh: 途中登船阶段曾观察到余额净少十七金币，
units.en: During embarkation, we observed a net decrease of 17 gold.

units.zh: 另一个窗口又净增加约零点二五；
units.en: In another window, it increased by about 0.25 net.

units.zh: 各自原因都没有逐笔付款账来证明。
units.en: Neither cause is established by an itemized payment ledger.

units.zh: 现在A和C各有真实到达观测，
units.en: A and C now each have an actual arrival observation.

units.zh: B因冻结条件未通过而停止；
units.en: B stopped after failing the fixed conditions.

units.zh: C又保留采样偏差，
units.en: C also retains its sampling deviations.

units.zh: 本次不能排出严格三方案的赢家。
units.en: This run cannot establish a winner in a strictly controlled three-plan comparison.

units.zh: 本期已经分别观察到补给回满、实际补兵、不同窗口的兵员减少，
units.en: We observed full supply, actual reinforcement, and soldier decreases in separate windows.

units.zh: 以及同日分合军的库存和组织变化。
units.en: We also observed supply and roster changes during same-day splits and merges.

units.zh: 后续休整也出现了真正的库存与人数增加。
units.en: Later rest periods produced actual increases in supply and soldier counts.

units.zh: 整军直走和换路线各自保留了真实到达观测；
units.en: The whole-army direct route and the alternate route each retain an actual arrival observation.

units.zh: 分兵方案因冻结条件变化停止，
units.en: The split-army plan stopped after its fixed conditions changed.

units.zh: 换路线回放又保留采样偏差，
units.en: The alternate-route replay retains sampling deviations.

units.zh: 因此没有严格三方案的胜负结论。
units.en: So there is no strictly controlled three-plan verdict.

units.zh: 真实饥饿和逐笔付款仍等待各自证据。
units.en: Actual starvation and itemized payments still need their own evidence.

units.zh: 你可以按这个顺序读自己的军队，
units.en: You can read your own army in this order.

units.zh: 再让每条新结论有自己的日期、身份和结果。
units.en: Give every new conclusion its own date, identity and observed result.
